TCP client 收發。本組全部走 buffer 模式（QIOPEN 末參數: TCP client send and receive. Everything in this group runs in buffer mode (last QIOPEN parameter 0) — ⚠ incoming data does NOT show up in the terminal by itself: the module emits a single +QIURC: "recv",<id> notification, and you have to press Read Data (AT+QIRD) yourself to fetch it, repeating the read until it returns +QIRD: 0 — otherwise the module will never issue the next notification. If no notification arrives, first check whether AT+QURCCFG="urcport" on the Hardware page is set to uart1 — if it is not, every URC is going out of the USB port instead. Also, the default peer tcpbin.com is a "line-oriented" echo server: unless the data you send ends with a newline (hex 0A) it just keeps buffering and sends nothing back (measured: without 0A, 6 s passed with no response at all; after appending a single 0A it came back within 0.1 s).

Limit 512 bytes. ⚠ That trailing 0A (newline) is not decoration: the default peer tcpbin.com is a "line-oriented" echo server, and until it sees a newline it just keeps buffering and sends nothing back — measured: sending Hello without 0A gave no response at all after 6 s, while appending a single 0A brought it back within 0.1 s.
